banner: Test payment page. No real payment is taken.
bannerNote: This page stands in for the payment provider's hosted checkout.
payHelp: The payment succeeds and Flux is told straight away.
payDelayed: Pay, but the confirmation is delayed
payDelayedHelp: The provider takes the payment, but its confirmation message to Flux is lost. The booking is confirmed later by the reconciliation job.
declineHelp: The payment fails. The slot stays held until the hold ends.
abandonHelp: Leave without paying. The slot stays held until the hold ends.
expiredText: The 15-minute hold ran out and the slot was released. Nothing was charged. Go back to the booking to see what to do next.
closedText: This session is no longer open. Go back to the booking to see its status.
notFoundTitle: We could not find this payment session
notFoundText: The link may be wrong or old. Open your bookings and start the payment again.
loadFailed: We could not load this payment session. Check your connection and try again.
actionFailed: That did not go through. Try again.
